'''Claudina Rodrigues-Pousada''' was a Portuguese researcher in biochemistry. She was a research student at the Gulbenkian Institute of Science until 1973 and at the   [[:fr:Institut de biologie physico-chimique|Institute of Physico-Chemical Biology]] (IBPC), Paris from 1973 to 1979 and [[Paris Diderot University]]. In 1979 she completed her PhD studies and in 1976 was employed by the Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation as an adjoint researcher at the Gulbenkian Institute of Science; in 1984 she was a senior researcher until 31 December 1999. In 2000 she moved to the Institute of Technology Chemical Biology as an invited full professor, where she launched the Genomics and Stress laboratory. She worked with [[yeast]] to examine how the [[fungi]] reacts to [[environmental stress|environmental stressors]], such as [[iron]], [[arsenic]], and [[nitric oxide]], and thus how these stressors regulate cellular  [[homeostasis]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.itqb.unl.pt/research/biological-chemistry/genomics-and-stress-laboratory|title=Claudina R. Pousada Lab — ITQB|last=|first=|date=|website=www.itqb.unl.pt|language=en-gb|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190315061817/http://www.itqb.unl.pt/research/biological-chemistry/genomics-and-stress-laboratory|archive-date=15 March 2019|access-date=2020-02-29}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.tsf.pt/sociedade/o-nosso-laboratorio-foi-o-primeiro-em-portugal-a-ter-genes-na-mao-5768932.html|title=O nosso laboratório foi o primeiro em Portugal a ter genes na mão|date=2017-04-04|website=TSF Rádio Notícias|language=pt|access-date=2020-02-29}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://expresso.pt/sociedade/cientista-portuguesa-distinguida=f425678|title=Cientista portuguesa distinguida|website=Jornal Expresso|language=pt-PT|access-date=2020-02-29}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Rodrigues-Pousada was born in 1941 in [[Tadim]], [[Portugal]],<ref name=":0">{{Cite journal|last=Rodrigues-Pousada|first=Claudina|date=2016-08-01|title=The birth of enthusiasm and passion for science|url= |journal=FEMS Yeast Research|language=en|volume=16|issue=5|article-number=fow057|doi=10.1093/femsyr/fow057|pmid=27371857|pmc=5815070|issn=1567-1356}}</ref> and died on 2 March 2021 in [[Lisbon]].<ref>{{cite web
| url = https://www.itqb.unl.pt/news/itqb-nova-mourns-claudina-rodrigues-pousada
| title = ITQB Nova mourns Claudina Rodrigues Pousada
| website=www.itqb.unl.pt
| access-date= 6 March 2021
}}</ref>

She graduated from the [[University of Porto]] with a degree in [[Pharmacy]] in 1968, though she started in [[Mathematics]].<ref name=":0" /> She was awarded her PhD in [[Biochemistry]] from the Institute of Physical and Chemical Biology.<ref name="itqb.unl.pt">{{Cite web|url=https://www.itqb.unl.pt/news/pharmaceutical-sector-recognizes-claudina-rodrigues-pousada|title=Pharmaceutical sector recognizes Claudina Rodrigues-Pousada — ITQB|website=www.itqb.unl.pt|access-date=2020-02-29}}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
In 1994 she was elected as a member of [[European Molecular Biology Organization|EMBO]].<ref>{{cite web|url = https://people.embo.org/profile/claudina-a-rodrigues-pousada|title = Deceased EMBO Member Claudina A. Rodrigues-Pousada}}</ref>

In 2009 Dr. Rodrigues-Pousada was awarded her university's "Figure of the Year" award.<ref name="itqb.unl.pt" />

In 2010 she received the Seeds of Science <!--Consagração--> award.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.itqb.unl.pt/news/claudina-rodrigues-pousada-receives-award|title=Claudina Rodrigues-Pousada receives award — ITQB|last=|first=|date=|website=www.itqb.unl.pt|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100529212131/http://www.itqb.unl.pt/news/claudina-rodrigues-pousada-receives-award|archive-date=29 May 2010|access-date=2020-02-29}}</ref>

In 2011 she was elected a Fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.itqb.unl.pt/news/claudina-rodrigues-pousada-elected-aaas-fellow|title=Claudina Rodrigues-Pousada elected AAAS Fellow — ITQB|website=www.itqb.unl.pt|access-date=2020-02-29}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/news/aaas-members-elected-fellows-2|title=AAAS Members Elected as Fellows|website=American Association for the Advancement of Science|language=en|access-date=2020-02-29}}</ref>
